findings.where: testimonial rating and hero chart, 1440 tiles 0-2
findings.evidence: The rating is five "★" characters with no text equivalent (read as "black star" five times); the hero bar chart is eight unlabeled divs with no role, title or alt, so assistive tech gets nothing or noise.
findings.after: <div class="stars" role="img" aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5">; chart wrapper role="img" aria-label="Example weekly active users chart" or aria-hidden="true" if decorative
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: every non-text element needs a text alternative or must be hidden as decoration.
findings.title: Images have text alternatives
findings.fix: Write what the image tells the reader, or alt="" if it tells nothing.
